properties.name: American sector
properties.source_name: Approximate 1945 sector reconstruction / Geoportal Berlin, ALKIS Berlin Ortsteile (modern proxy; Staaken excluded)
properties.reconstruction_method: Historical borough assignment and dissolve; reviewed adjustments only
properties.excluded_coverage_notes: Entire modern Staaken locality omitted; no claim of complete 1945 coverage.
properties.uncertainty_notes: Historical boundaries are reconstructed and may differ from their exact 1945 locations. Modern ALKIS locality edges are geographic proxies, not verified 1945 linework. Entire modern Staaken locality excluded: both British East Staaken and Soviet-zone West Staaken remain unclassified. Gatow/Seeburger Zipfel exchange outline remains unresolved; modern Gatow/Kladow edges retained only as approximate proxies. Later exchanges, Steinstuecken corridor, eastern city-limit additions and small internal boundary shifts are not reversed. Not suitable for building/address-level historical classification, especially near boundaries.
